Ram Temple Trust CEO Aspirants Asked About Dietary Habits, Religious Practices

Interviews for the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) position at the Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust began on August 11. Out of over 5,300 applications, 18 candidates were shortlisted. The interview process reportedly included questions about dietary preferences (vegetarianism, non-vegetarianism), religious practices (wearing Janeu, keeping Shikha), and alcohol consumption. Candidates were also questioned on their administrative experience, vision, and understanding of temple management and crowd control. The final decision rests with the Trust, and the executive appointee will not have independent decision-making authority.
